mines.mine_notes: Flagship development project, Golden Triangle, BC. Under construction (~49% complete per Mar 31, 2026 update); initial production expected Q2 2027. 2023 DFS figures: LOM avg ~320,000 oz AuEq/yr; LOM AISC US$300/oz Au net of silver by-product credits (US$687/oz AuEq co-product); 12-year processing life (3-year commissioning + open pit + 9-year underground); pre-production capex C$713M; after-tax NPV5% C$1,973M and IRR 42.7% at $1,700/oz Au, $21.50/oz Ag. 2025 spent C$356.2M on development; cash at YE2025 C$598.9M. FS economics per feasibility study; not yet in production.
mines.processing: Planned: conventional grinding, flotation and cyanidation
mines.status: Development (under construction; first production expected Q2 2027)
